# has segment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSegment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

Relates a whole (work, release, installment, or another segment) to a structural part. Non-functional: a work may have many segments. Inverse of [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md).
